listed_NASA_resource_effectively_used.name: Horizons System
listed_NASA_resource_effectively_used.role: Stored reference observations and angular cross-model comparison

limitations: Bounded and discretized terrain, no obstacles below effective DEM resolution
Point-center criterion, no full disc fraction or atmospheric refraction, eclipses not modeled
Geometric NONE is not identical to apparent light-time-corrected visibility
No radio link budget, power production, thermal survival or landing certification
Only five published clones, not the complete 100-member ensemble
Synthetic X=1 m is an editable hypothesis, not a calibrated LOLA uncertainty
Horizon beyond 400 km excluded conditionally under 12 km global-height ceiling
Time intervals use left-sample 10 minute bins; event times are brackets
